title: 第8章 选课这件事
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
正式上课的第一天，安槐就遇到了一个意料之外的问题。

    选课。

    青岚武道高中的课程分必修和选修两大类。

    必修课包括武道基础、文化理论、联邦通识，每个人都得上，选修课则根据个人方向自由选择，每人至少选两门。

    课表发下来的时候，苏念念趴在桌上研究了半天，嘴里念念有词。

    “近身格斗、兵器入门、灵气感知、阵法基础、丹药常识、身法训练……”她念着念着回头看安槐，“你选什么？”

    安槐扫了一眼课表。

    “灵气感知和丹药常识。”

    “为什么？”

    “灵气感知对突破六重有帮助，丹药常识可以省钱。”

    苏念念想了想，觉得这逻辑无懈可击，点了点头。

    “那我也选这两个。”

    “老大不考虑近身格斗吗？苏家的功法配合近身格斗的步法训练会事半功倍。”

    苏念念愣了一下。

    “你怎么知道苏家功法适合近身格斗？”

    安槐翻了一页课表，语气随意：“苏叔叔以前教你练功我在旁边看过几次，苏家断岳拳主打短距离爆发，和近身格斗的步法互补性很强。”

    苏念念盯着他看了三秒钟。

    “你看几次就看出来了？”

    “嗯。”

    苏念念抬手狠狠揉了一把他的脑袋，揉完又捏了两下他的脸。

    “你这脑子到底是什么做的？行，那我选近身格斗和灵气感知，你帮我填表。”

    安槐接过她的选课表，工工整整填好，签上她的名字，笔迹和苏念念本人的如出一辙。

    苏念念低头看了一眼。

    “你什么时候学会模仿我的字的？”

    “小学三年级。”

    “……你有没有拿我的字干过什么坏事？”

    “帮你签过三次家长联系册。”

    苏念念的嘴角抽了一下，想骂他，仔细一想又觉得这小子确实帮了忙，只好哼了一声。

    后桌的周小鱼探过头来。

    “念念念念，你们选了什么？我也不知道选什么好，你帮我参谋参谋呗。”

    苏念念的社交恐怖分子模式瞬间激活，她转身趴到后桌，两个人的脑袋凑在一起叽叽喳喳说了起来。

    安槐低头填自己的选课表，余光注意到教室另一头有动静。

    林落雪坐在角落的位置上，手里拿着选课表，像是拿不定主意的样子，她微微侧头，目光扫过周围，最后落在了斜前方沈晨的背影上。

    两秒后，她站起来，抱着选课表走向沈晨的方向。

    “沈晨同学，不好意思打扰一下……我不太了解这些选修课，能问你一下吗？”

    声音轻柔，语尾带着一点不确定的上扬，像是连开口问个问题都觉得不好意思。

    沈晨立刻转过身，笑容比窗外的阳光还灿烂。
content_en:
On the first day of class, An Huai encountered an unexpected problem.

Select courses.

The courses at Qinglan Martial Arts High School are divided into two categories: compulsory and elective.

The compulsory courses include martial arts basics, cultural theory, and federal general knowledge. Everyone must take them. Elective courses can be chosen freely according to personal direction. Each person can choose at least two courses.

When the class schedule was handed out, Su Niannian lay on the table and studied for a long time, mumbling something.

"Close combat, introduction to weapons, aura perception, basics of formations, common knowledge of elixirs, body training..." She looked back at An Huai as she read, "What do you choose?"

An Huai glanced at the class schedule.

"Aura perception and common knowledge about elixirs."

"Why?"

"Aura perception is helpful to break through the sixth level, and knowledge about elixirs can save money."

Su Niannian thought about it and felt that the logic was impeccable, and nodded.

"Then I'll choose these two too."

"Boss, don't you think about close combat? The Su family's martial arts combined with the footwork training of close combat will get twice the result with half the effort."

Su Niannian was stunned for a moment.

"How do you know that the Su family's martial arts are suitable for close combat?"

An Huai flipped through a page of the class schedule and said in a casual tone: "Uncle Su taught you martial arts before and I watched him several times. The Su family's Duanyue Fist focuses on short-range bursts, and it is very complementary to the footwork of close combat."

Su Niannian stared at him for three seconds.

"How many times did you see it before you could tell?"

"Yeah."

Su Niannian raised her hand and rubbed his head hard, then pinched his face twice.

"What is your brain made of? Okay, then I'll choose close combat and aura perception, and you can help me fill out the form."

An Huai took her course selection form, filled it out carefully, and signed her name. The handwriting was exactly the same as Su Niannian's.

Su Niannian glanced down.

"When did you learn to imitate my handwriting?"

"Third grade of elementary school."

"...Have you ever done anything bad with my words?"

"I have signed the parent contact book for you three times."

The corner of Su Niannian's mouth twitched, wanting to scold him, but after thinking about it carefully, she felt that this boy had indeed helped, so she had to snort.

Zhou Xiaoyu, who was at the back table, looked over.

"Niannianniannian, what did you choose? I don't know what to choose. You can help me give advice."

Su Niannian's social terrorist mode was activated instantly. She turned around and lay down on the back table, and the two of them put their heads together and started chattering.

An Huai lowered his head to fill out his course selection form, and noticed movement at the other end of the classroom from the corner of his eye.

Lin Luoxue was sitting in the corner, holding a course selection list in her hand, as if she couldn't make up her mind. She turned her head slightly, glanced around, and finally landed on Shen Chen's back diagonally in front of her.

Two seconds later, she stood up and walked towards Shen Chen holding her course schedule.

"Student Shen Chen, I'm sorry to bother you... I don't know much about these elective courses. Can I ask you a question?"

His voice was soft, with a slightly uncertain rise at the end of his words, as if he was embarrassed to even ask a question.

Shen Chen immediately turned around, his smile brighter than the sunshine outside the window.
